name: Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition

eax.problem: The Enhanced Edition runs on a from-scratch OpenAL engine, built for its native Linux and macOS ports — it never had DirectSound3D EAX to begin with.

notes: If you also own the classic build, it's a separate GOG product the scanner detects on its own — see the 'Baldur's Gate: The Original Saga' entry (gog_id 1207658886), which has real DirectSound3D EAX.
